context: A mom hears her young son's disappointment about a school trip
purpose: Teach: 言うまでもない/とどまっ/ムダ/食わ/ピッタリ/成る/無言/失望

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、遠足、中止だって……。すっごくがっかりした。
lines.en: Mom, the field trip... they cancelled it. I'm super bummed.
lines.style: Small child voice, voice cracking with held-back tears, slow and heavy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あらら、楽しみにしてたもんね。ショウくんが失望する気持ち、ママもよく分かるよ。
lines.en: Oh dear, you were looking forward to it. Mom understands how let down you feel, Sho.
lines.style: Warm motherly tone, soft and slow, kneeling down to her child's eye level.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ……お弁当も、ピッタリのサイズの箱に詰めてくれたのに……。
lines.en: ...And you even packed my lunch in that perfectly-sized box...
lines.style: Pauses in silence first, then mumbles quietly while looking down at the floor.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうそう、ショウくんの好物ばっかり入れたんだよ。ムダにはならないから、お家で食べよっか?
lines.en: That's right, I packed all your favorites. It won't go to waste, so let's eat it at home, okay?
lines.style: Gentle upbeat suggestion, motherly warmth, lifting the mood without forcing cheer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ……うん。バスにも乗れないし、無言でうつむくしかないよぉ……。
lines.en: ...Yeah. I can't even ride the bus, all I can do is look down and stay quiet...
lines.style: Still subdued, voice barely above a whisper, dragging out the final word sadly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねぇ、お家にとどまってるのも寂しいから、ママと動物園に行かない?きっと元気に成るよ。
lines.en: Hey, just staying cooped up at home is lonely, so wanna go to the zoo with Mom? You'll perk right up.
lines.style: Bright inviting tone, gentle suggestion, voice rising with hopeful energy at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ほんと?ペンギンに餌あげるとこ見たい!飼育員さんがお魚食わせるんでしょ?
lines.en: Really? I wanna see them feed the penguins! The keeper shoves fish in their mouths, right?
lines.style: Sudden burst of excitement, voice jumping up an octave, childlike eagerness throughout.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、よし決まり!お弁当持って行こうね。言うまでもないけど、走ったら危ないよ?
lines.en: Hehe, alright, it's decided! Let's bring the lunch. Needless to say, no running around, okay?
lines.style: Cheerful and decisive, warm teasing tone, motherly relief mixed with playful caution.
